excerpt: DailyHelm is an AI business reviewer that checks your analytics, ads, SEO, code and costs overnight and sends a morning list of fixes ranked by revenue impact. Pricing, alternatives and launch-day Q&A.
content:
DailyHelm connects to an online business's data (Google Analytics, ad accounts, SEO, Stripe, GitHub and others) and reviews it overnight. Instead of a dashboard, you get a morning brief: a prioritised list of issues and opportunities, each ranked by likely revenue impact, such as broken conversion tracking, wasted ad spend or a slower checkout page. Findings can go to Slack, a PDF, a shareable link, or your own tools through an API and webhooks.

The work is split between six specialist AI agents (analytics and growth, ads, SEO, code, cloud cost and site UX) coordinated by an orchestrator called Aria, which you can also chat with. DailyHelm says every connector is read-only, so it never changes anything in your accounts. Founder Brandon Dennis said on Product Hunt that connecting the integrations takes about ten minutes.

DailyHelm launched on Product Hunt on 5 October 2026 and finished #5 for the day with 216 points and 65 comments (as of 14 October 2026).

We have not tested DailyHelm ourselves. This page brings together its official site, its Product Hunt page and the public pages of the products it is compared with, and says where each fact comes from.

profile.platform: Web app with Slack delivery and an API
profile.summary_short: AI agents that review your analytics, ads, SEO and costs overnight and send a ranked list of fixes

gallery.alt: DailyHelm graphic 'Your business, reviewed by AI. Every morning.' with a Business Health screen listing today's priorities by severity and revenue at risk
DailyHelm graphic 'Six specialists. One morning brief.' showing six robot agents for analytics, ads, SEO, code, cost and site UX

fit: run a SaaS, e-commerce or agency business and check several dashboards every morning
want problems ranked by money at stake rather than more charts
want read-only access: DailyHelm says its connectors never change anything
not_fit: need a free plan: the site sells paid plans with a 14-day money-back guarantee
want a full product-analytics suite with funnels and session replays (see Mixpanel below)
run several businesses on one subscription: the site says each business has its own plan and billing

pricing.intro: DailyHelm lists one plan with three billing terms on its own pricing page, shown as sale prices against a $99/month list price. Prices are in US dollars.

plans.name: Monthly
plans.detail: All 6 specialist agents plus the Aria orchestrator, 500 Aria chat credits a month, unlimited user seats, 24/7 support

notes: As shown on 14 October 2026, the monthly sale price was lower than the quarterly and annual ones; check the page before choosing a term.
Extra Aria chat credits cost $49 per 1,000.
Every plan has a 14-day money-back guarantee and can be cancelled any time. The founder mentioned a 7-day full-access trial on Product Hunt; the pricing page does not list one.
Each business needs its own plan.

alternatives.intro: These are products Product Hunt lists as alternatives. Review scores are Product Hunt users' own.

items.name: Mixpanel
items.starts_at: Free to start; Growth plan priced by usage
items.difference: A full analytics tool you explore yourself. DailyHelm reads tools like this and tells you what to fix.

items.name: Mikrolo
items.what: Catches marketing issues before you overspend
items.difference: Focused on marketing and ad issues; DailyHelm also covers SEO, code, cloud cost and site UX.

items.name: Houseware
items.what: AI agents for digital experience teams
items.difference: Aimed at digital-experience teams in larger companies rather than founders' daily review.

alternatives.more: Product Hunt also lists MarketRecon and Predflow AI. DailyHelm's own site has comparison pages against Databox, AgencyAnalytics, Klipfolio, Triple Whale and Baremetrics.

quotes.author: Shivam Kushwaha
quotes.text: This looks useful for tracking broken conversions and wasted ad spend. What's the setup time like for the integrations?
quotes.reply: Brandon Dennis: integrations take a few clicks, and all connectors can be set up within 10 minutes.

quotes.author: Irene Chan
quotes.text: As a founder, I'm guilty of having a bunch of dashboards and google sheets.

x.none: We did not check X for this profile.

faq.a: An AI business reviewer that connects to your analytics, ads, SEO, store and code data, reviews it overnight and sends a prioritised list of fixes ranked by likely revenue impact.

On 14 October 2026 the pricing page showed $49 a month billed monthly, $66 a month billed quarterly and $69 a month billed annually, each against a $99 list price. All plans include the same features.
The pricing page offers a 14-day money-back guarantee rather than a free plan. The founder mentioned a 7-day full-access trial on Product Hunt.

faq.q: Can DailyHelm change my ad or analytics settings?
faq.a: No, according to DailyHelm: every connector is read-only.

faq.q: Which tools does it connect to?
faq.a: Its site lists integrations including Slack, Google Analytics, GitHub and Stripe, plus ad and SEO data, and offers an API and webhooks.

faq.q: How did DailyHelm do on Product Hunt?
faq.a: It launched on 5 October 2026 and finished #5 for the day with 216 points and 65 comments.
